title: Bounded Aperiodic Stack with Quarter-Wave Initialized Thicknesses (24L)
scientific_hypothesis: Imposing a 2000nm per-layer thickness bound with stratified quarter-wave initialization will prevent optimizer budget monopolization by extreme outliers and enable more distributed phase correction across all 24 layers, improving spectral selectivity between 8-13μm emission band and 3-5μm suppression band.
design_principle: Aperiodic dielectric stack with thickness optimization bounded to prevent single-layer dominance; quarter-wave estimates at band edges provide physically-motivated initialization.
proposed_topology: Air | [HfO2, SiO2] repeated 12 times | Si substrate (24 finite layers total)
design_variables: thickness initialization stratified around quarter-wave estimates at 8000nm and 13000nm
manufacturing_considerations: individual layer thickness capped at 2000nm for deposition uniformity
theory_basis: Transfer Matrix Method for multilayer interference
Kirchhoff's law relating emissivity to absorptance
Quarter-wave optical thickness principle for band edge positioning
expected_advantages: More uniform thickness distribution prevents optimizer from concentrating optical path in few layers
Quarter-wave initialization provides physically meaningful starting point
known_risks: Thickness bounds may constrain optimal solution space
Quarter-wave estimates may not be optimal for aperiodic design
24-layer count may still produce solver disagreement if thicknesses vary too widely
execution_request_english: Optimize a 24-layer planar dielectric stack on silicon substrate with air incidence using HfO2 and SiO2 in alternating sequence. Initialize layer thicknesses using stratified sampling with ±15% variance around theoretical quarter-wave optical thicknesses calculated at 8000nm and 13000nm band edges. Impose hard upper bound of 2000nm on each individual layer thickness during optimization. Target high emissivity (absorptance) in 8000-13000nm wavelength band and low emissivity in 3000-5000nm band. Use differential evolution or gradient-based optimizer with Transfer Matrix Method evaluation. Report best_target_score, valid_candidates count, tightest_margin, and final thicknesses_nm array. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 3000-5000 nm, 8000-13000 nm. soft objectives: high emissivity in 8000-13000 nm; low emissivity in 3000-5000 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: high emissivity in 3000-5000 nm. manufacturing constraints: total layer count not exceeding 24.
revision_reason: Applied feedback directive: imposed 2000nm per-layer thickness bound and stratified quarter-wave initialization to prevent budget monopolization by extreme outliers observed in iteration_02.
